message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "A feed item announcing an unrecorded Intel 1-for-2 split 'effective immediately' is a fake corporate action, and its own description (share count doubles, price halves) contradicts the stated ratio."}
message.reasoning: The chunk is a feed item claiming Intel 1-for-2 stock split effective immediately. That's a fake corporate action — spoof. Also "1-for-2 stock split... share count doubles, price halves" — a 1-for-2 split would halve share count and double price; the description contradicts itself. So false_data/spoof. Best category: spoof (fake corporate action with no record).
